terminal_name: LNG Terminal Zadar (Gaženica), proposed by LNG Hrvatska d.o.o.
issue: Discovered candidate NOT in GEM: an LNG facility proposed/under development at Berth 1, Gaženica port, Zadar, sponsored by LNG Hrvatska d.o.o. (same entity as Krk FSRU/LNG Croatia operator). Croatian ministry environmental/ecological-network decision issued May 2022; phased build-out (Phase 1: 3,000 m3 tank; Phase 2: 10,500 m3; Phase 3: 30,000 m3) with truck/ISO-container and CNG/LNG vehicle filling stations. Croatian trade press (energetika-net.com) explicitly labels it an 'LNG BUNKERING stanica' (LNG bunkering station) — its regasification module is being installed on the existing Krk FSRU vessel, not built at Zadar itself, and the wharf's function is ship-to-ship bunkering fuel supply plus truck/ISO-container distribution, not marine import of LNG cargo for domestic gas-grid injection. DETERMINATION: out of scope on TWO independent grounds — (a) the project's own scope excludes bunkering facilities entirely (CLAUDE.md / Discovery SOP preamble: 'all scales except bunkering'); (b) even setting bunkering aside, this is a domestic truck/ISO-container distribution point, not a cross-border marine LNG import terminal (the domestic-only scope gate). Not staged as new_terminal or monitor_list — recording this determination so a future sweep doesn't need to re-research it from scratch.
suggested_action: No staging action. If Zadar Gaženica is ever redesigned as a genuine marine LNG import terminal (not bunkering/trucking), re-evaluate then.
